text:
sara: Heads up — noticed quota/billing attribution weirdness for org-scoped API keys going through service-account proxies. Billing shows a bunch of tokens attributed to the org root instead of the originating project. Sample trace id: req-4f6b.

james: Yup saw that spike. Quick grep in logs:
```
2026-03-20T10:12:03Z req-4f6b auth-proxy: token-exchange user=sa-analytics project=proj-123 forwarded_project=null billing=org-567
```
Looks like the proxy is dropping the original project claim.

korin: We intentionally strip untrusted headers in auth-proxy for safety, but I think we never re-populated the origin project claim into the exchanged token that billing reads. My bad.

alex: If we just add an `X-Original-Project` header back in, billing could be tricked unless the proxy signs the claim. We should sign the claim or include it as a signed JWT claim during token exchange.

maria: Agreed. Proposal: auth-proxy emits an `orig_project` claim inside the exchanged JWT (signed with the proxy key). Billing ingestion verifies signature against the proxy public key. That avoids header spoofing and keeps pipeline changes minimal.

james: +1. From the console/UX side product wants per-project cost by model+route. If we don't have a reliable origin claim we'll keep seeing noisy "unknown" buckets. Dashboard should show unknown + reason.

korin: I can push a small change to auth-proxy to include `orig_project` in the exchange token and sign it with the existing proxy key. Will gate under feature flag `signed-origin-claim` so we can rollout gradually.

alex: I'll add verification in billing-ingestion: check `orig_project` signature, fall back to current attribution heuristics if missing or invalid. Also add a metric `billing.attribution.invalid_signature` so we can monitor failure modes.

maria: For the Console: show a new card in cost breakdown "Attribution quality" with buckets: verified, heuristic, unknown. Add tooltip that explains signed-origin rollout and a link to docs.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary auth-proxy v2.3.1 -> us-east-1; flag `signed-origin-claim=true` on 10% hosts.

james: We should also update quota routing — if project can't be verified, we should keep default org-level quota but emit `quota.attribution=heuristic` telemetry so SRE can spot bad spikes.

sara: Plan: Korin pushes proxy signing change behind flag; Alex updates billing ingestion verification and telemetry; Maria adds dashboard fallback and tooltip; James to wire quota telemetry. Sync 11:00am tomorrow.

sara: :thumbsup:
